title: Support for .NET Framework 4, 4.5 and 4.5.1 ends
impact: Machines must have .NET Framework 4.5.2 or later installed to keep getting security updates for 4.x apps

title: Extended support for SQL Server 2005 ends
impact: Databases still on 2005 get no more security updates and must move to a newer version, retesting app SQL

title: SQL Server 2016 becomes generally available
impact: JSON functions, STRING_SPLIT, DROP IF EXISTS, temporal tables and Always Encrypted become usable on databases moved to 2016

title: Windows Server 2016 becomes generally available
impact: Containers and Nano Server arrive, and licensing moves to per-core, changing the cost of hosting business apps
